caption: The drawing depicts a single, shallow bowl situated in the center of the composition. The bowl is rendered in varying shades of purple, with darker tones used to indicate the base and interior shadows, while lighter purples depict the highlighted and thinner areas of the glass-like material. The shape of the bowl is wide, with a gently flaring rim and a narrow, slightly raised base. The background is plain and off-white, and there are no additional objects or patterns present. To the lower right of the bowl, the name "V. L. VANCE" is written in small, simple capital letters.
title: Amethyst Glass Bowl
